summary: Describes the ansible-core workflow on GitHub: changes go to devel with changelog fragments, bug fixes (not features) are backported to up to three stable branches by severity, and minor releases ship every four weeks.
questions: Are new features backported to older ansible-core versions?
Where do ansible-core changes get merged first?
How are bug fixes backported in ansible-core?
Will a bug be fixed in an unmaintained ansible-core version?

answer_card.title: ansible-core development workflow
answer_card.answer_md:
- New features and fixes go to the **devel** branch, each with a changelog fragment.
- Bug fixes are backported to one, two or three stable branches depending on severity. **Features are not backported.**
- Each maintained version gets a minor release every four weeks.
- A feature freeze starts the next release.

Unmaintained releases generally get no fixes except occasionally for critical issues.
